description: An opportunity or event with a deadline and a project to build for it.

fields.name: string — the hackathon or challenge name
fields.deadline: string — ISO date/time if determinable, otherwise the raw phrase mentioned
fields.source: string — where this was seen (link, platform, or person who mentioned it)
fields.projectIdea: string — any project/idea already associated with it, else empty
fields.techStack: array of strings — any technologies mentioned or implied
fields.resources: array of strings — links or references mentioned
fields.tasks: array of strings — a short starter task list (e.g. pick idea, scope build, write submission)
fields.status: string — one of: potential, in-progress, submitted
